reason: I already have a supplement I reorder when it runs out, and I'm not looking to switch. Single-use foil sachets every day feel like a lot of packaging waste to me.
objection: 30 foil sachets a month is more trash, and I already have a routine with a brand I know.
would_change_my_mind: A free sample or a much lower first-box price, plus proof the sachets are recyclable or that a refill pouch option exists.
